guard.note: canUse: night -> false; level.getEntitiesOfClass(RibbitEntity, bb.inflate(64, 16, 64)) (the wrapped search) -> stream, playing ones: take their master; band full -> drop it; alive and not falling

tick: without a playing master the same search and adoption, then path / look / play; the list is only streamed, never kept; the player search (getEntitiesOfClass with a predicate) is another overload and not wrapped
the wrapped overload: getEntitiesOfClass(class, box, EntitySelector.NO_SPECTATORS), the entities whose bounding box intersects the box

ribbits_band_scan_interval.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the Level.getEntitiesOfClass(RibbitEntity, box) call in RibbitPlayMusicGoal.canUse and tick (Ribbits 1.21.1-NeoForge-4.1.6, the same shape as 3.0.2): the goal keeps its last search's list (@Unique fields) and for the next N - 1 calls answers it filtered by the current box (the search's own intersects test); a removed ribbit in it or a level change searches again at once. Trade-off, off by default; N = PureConfig.intValue("ribbits_band_scan_interval", 10, 1, 200). Runtime flag ribbitsBandScanInterval. Helper bons.furious.patch.ribbits_coo49.BandScan.
ribbits_band_scan_interval.license: Ribbits (LGPLv3 per its 1.21.1 mods.toml): no code carried; the hook decides when its own search runs
